&api-questions;
The NetBeansFX Project Customizer API lets project-type modules contribute categories to the JavaFX Project Properties dialog.
Panels are registered with @ServiceProvider and selected by project-kind id and position.
Used by the nbfx project-type modules and the navigator; under development until the MVP freeze.
Unit tests run on the nbfx module harness (nbjunit); the check-purity.xml guardrail enforces UI purity.
All user-visible strings live in Bundle.properties and are read with NbBundle.
UI work runs on the JavaFX Application Thread; background work marshals back with Platform.runLater.
Implementations register with @ServiceProvider or the nbfx layer annotations (NbFx/*).
Layer entries are generated by the nbfx annotation processors; this API declares none.
No special requirements.
